content.name: Efficient Quiver
entries: Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds. The shortest compartment can hold up to sixty {@item arrow|srd51|arrows}, {@item crossbow bolt|srd51|bolts}, or similar objects. The midsize compartment holds up to eighteen {@item javelin|srd51|javelins} or similar objects. The longest compartment holds up to six long objects, such as bows, {@item quarterstaff|srd51|quarterstaffs}, or {@item spear|srd51|spears}.
You can draw any item the quiver contains as if doing so from a regular quiver or scabbard.
